system.description:
CONCENTRATE MANIPULATE VERDANT WARDING
Action 10 minutes
You fashion a small protective charm from appropriate materials: a knotted cord, carved token, herb bundle, inscribed stone, nail, feather or similar object.
Choose one of the following protections when you create the charm:
Mind Fear effects, effects with the Mental trait and supernatural Sleep effects.
Soul Possession, Soul Drain and effects with the Soul trait.
Hex Effects with the Curse trait.
The charm becomes one of your active Preparations. A creature carrying the charm may activate it as a Reaction immediately before attempting an eligible saving throw. The creature gains a circumstance bonus to the triggering saving throw equal to half your Folkwarden class bonus (round up). The charm is then expended.

Use: choose the protection (two for a Charmwright), then the charm lands as an effect on you or the targeted creature carrying the circumstance bonus (half your class bonus, rounded up) pre-ticked on matching saves. It is one of your Preparations; delete the effect when it is expended.
